nodes.description: Proxy.fallback() external payable entrypoint that routes all unknown calldata to _fallback().
Proxy._fallback() internal assembly routine that sloads the EIP-1967 implementation slot and delegatecalls it with full calldata.
Proxy.receive() external payable virtual default handler that reverts with ETHER_REJECTED.
Proxy._setImplementation(address,bytes) internal function storing the new implementation slot, emitting ProxyImplementationUpdated and optionally delegatecalling init data.
EIP173Proxy constructor(address,bytes,address) payable that initialises implementation and owner.
EIP173Proxy.owner() external view returning the stored admin address via _owner().
EIP173Proxy.supportsInterface(bytes4) external view that reads the implementation slot and try/calls implementation.supportsInterface(id).
EIP173Proxy.transferOwnership(address) external onlyOwner that writes a new owner.
EIP173Proxy.changeImplementation(address,bytes) external payable onlyOwner that swaps the implementation and optionally delegatecalls data.
onlyOwner modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the owner read from the EIP-1967 owner slot.
EIP173Proxy._owner() internal view assembly sload of the owner storage slot.
EIP173Proxy._setOwner(address) internal function that reads the previous owner, sstores the new owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
EIP173ProxyWithReceive constructor forwarding to EIP173Proxy constructor.
EIP173ProxyWithReceive.receive() external payable override that accepts ETH without reverting.
msg.sender used in onlyOwner authorization comparison.
delegatecall(gas(), implementationAddress, 0x0, calldatasize(), 0, 0) inside Proxy._fallback executing untrusted implementation code in proxy context.
newImplementation.delegatecall(data) in _setImplementation executing caller-supplied data in proxy context.
assembly sstore of the EIP-1967 implementation slot 0x360894...382bbc in _setImplementation.
assembly sstore of the owner slot 0xb53127...5d6103 in _setOwner (privileged ownership mutation).
bytes4 id parameter of supportsInterface, compared against magic values and forwarded to the implementation.
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
address newImplementation parameter of changeImplementation.
bytes calldata data parameter of changeImplementation.
address newImplementation parameter of _setImplementation.
bytes memory data parameter of _setImplementation, delegatecalled when non-empty.
address newOwner parameter of _setOwner.
previousImplementation local holding the slot value read before overwriting it in _setImplementation.
implementation local of type ERC165 loaded from the implementation slot in supportsInterface.
bool support returned by the try call to implementation.supportsInterface in supportsInterface.
previousOwner local captured before the owner slot is overwritten in _setOwner.
implementationAddress local loaded from the implementation slot in _fallback.
success flag returned by the delegatecall in _fallback controlling revert vs return.

edges.reason: fallback() external payable invokes the internal _fallback() dispatcher.
EIP173Proxy constructor calls _setImplementation to initialise the implementation slot.
EIP173Proxy constructor calls _setOwner to initialise the owner slot.
EIP173ProxyWithReceive constructor invokes the base EIP173Proxy constructor.
changeImplementation is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier; a missing or weak check lets any caller swap the implementation.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier controlling privileged ownership transfer.
onlyOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner address to authorize privileged calls.
onlyOwner obtains the current owner value from _owner() for the authorization comparison.
owner() returns the value produced by _owner().
_setOwner reads the current owner via _owner() before overwriting it.
changeImplementation forwards the new implementation and data to _setImplementation.
transferOwnership forwards the new owner address to _setOwner.
_fallback executes the unsafe delegatecall into the implementation address.
_fallback loads the implementation slot value into the implementationAddress local.
the storage-derived implementation address is used as the delegatecall target.
the delegatecall result is captured in the success local controlling revert/return.
_setImplementation delegatecalls the supplied data to the new implementation when data.length > 0.
_setImplementation performs the sstore that overwrites the EIP-1967 implementation slot.
_setOwner performs the sstore that overwrites the owner slot.
_setImplementation reads the previous implementation into the previousImplementation local before the sstore.
_setOwner stores the current owner in the previousOwner local before the sstore and event.
supportsInterface loads the implementation slot into the local ERC165 implementation reference.
supportsInterface captures the returned boolean of the external try call in the support local.
the bytes4 id parameter is consumed by supportsInterface for the magic-value checks and external call.
supportsInterface makes an external ERC165 call to the implementation contract, enabling an external callback into callee-controlled code.
the newImplementation parameter is consumed by changeImplementation.
the data parameter is consumed by changeImplementation.
the newImplementation parameter is consumed by _setImplementation.
the data parameter is consumed by _setImplementation.
the new implementation address flows into the sstore of the EIP-1967 implementation slot.
the caller-supplied data flows into the delegatecall payload executed in proxy context.
the newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
the new owner address is forwarded into _setOwner.
the newOwner parameter is consumed by _setOwner.
the new owner address flows into the sstore of the owner slot.
EIP173ProxyWithReceive.receive overrides the default reverting Proxy.receive handler and accepts ETH.

normalization_plan.reason: The bytes4 id parameter has no independent security identity; it is only meaningful as the argument consumed by supportsInterface.
The newOwner parameter of transferOwnership is a transient argument of the ownership-transfer entrypoint.
The newImplementation parameter of changeImplementation is a transient argument of that onlyOwner entrypoint.
The data parameter of changeImplementation is a transient calldata argument of that entrypoint.
The newImplementation parameter is the value written into the implementation slot by _setImplementation.
The data parameter is the payload delegatecalled by _setImplementation.
The newOwner parameter is the value written into the owner slot by _setOwner.
previousImplementation is only a temporary holder for the slot value read inside _setImplementation for the event.
The local ERC165 implementation reference is a temporary alias for the implementation slot used only inside supportsInterface.
The support boolean is only the return value of the external call inside supportsInterface.
previousOwner is a temporary holder of the old owner used only for the OwnershipTransferred event in _setOwner.
implementationAddress exists only as the loaded delegatecall target inside _fallback.
The success flag is only the delegatecall result used for the revert/return switch inside _fallback.
